distribution.narrative: The reviewed source records Acacicis aphananthe from Taiwan. The type locality is Taichung City, Heping District, 654 m, 24°9.8210'N, 120°57.4140'E; the type series was collected on 29 July 2020.
distribution.evidence: Lin & Beaver (2021), type locality: Taichung City, Heping District, Taiwan.

host_note: The complete type series was collected from Aphananthe aspera; the reviewed source describes phloeophagous development in twigs, branches and limbs.
taxonomy_summary: Acacicis aphananthe Lin & Beaver, 2021 is the currently accepted name for VSN_0001.

taxonomic_history.name: Acacicis aphananthe
taxonomic_history.note: Described as a new species. The original name and current accepted name are the same in the integrated nomenclatural backbone.

nomenclature_note: No additional synonyms, historical combinations, misspellings, replacement names, or homonyms are currently linked to VSN_0001.

resources.images: Adult morphology, galleries and life stages are illustrated in Fig. 1; proventriculus in Fig. 7A of the original description.
resources.specimens: Holotype female and 51 male + 28 female paratypes from the type locality; specimens distributed among NMNS and cited collections.
resources.molecular: No molecular accession is reported in the integrated source.
